systems.system: Isali electronic payment project in Northern State
systems.owner: Northern State Ministry of Finance, through a state technical committee that coordinates with the federal technical committee
systems.tiers: four phases: data entry for the state headquarters units; activation in the state's ministries, councils, secretariats and other units; activation in the localities; then field collection and small rural hospitals. The project is put at 95 per cent complete; which phases are finished is not stated

note: The head of Northern State's technical committee puts the state's Isali project at 95 per cent and lists the committee's support as devices, training and the provision of networks. Activation in the localities is named as the third of four phases without a statement that any locality is live, and no network is placed at a locality's office; the project is the state's, the upper tier. The body prints no date; the published date, 2026-06-12, is a proxy.
